conceptZh: 太空人玩偶背了超大背包，用小玩意兒撐住自己，累得軟掉，字也跟著沉下來。
object: a bouncy astronaut toy in a fishbowl helmet with an enormous backpack
morph: an oversized backpack of pieces sags the astronaut down while the strokes of 累 pile up
creativeAngle: 尺寸差異：背包太大、人太小，累到漂不起來。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale peach background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 累 as the only text on screen, drawn in deep teal solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a chunky astronaut toy bounces in, tiny beside a ridiculous backpack three times its size stuffed with glowing stroke-shaped bricks; first 累 is spoken as the top 田 block pops off the pack and lands up top. 1.7-3.5s: he tries to lift off to carry it, floats up a little, then the pack drags him down with a squeak; the second 累 is spoken as the 糸 strokes unspool out of the pack and settle below like soft ribbons. 3.5-5s: he improvises by rolling the empty pack like a beanbag and flopping onto it as 好累 is spoken, helmet fogging, limbs splayed, a tiny floating zzz bubble of stars (no text) drifting upward. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "累、累、好累" (ㄌㄟˋ、ㄌㄟˋ、ㄏㄠˇ ㄌㄟˋ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 累 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
